northStar: One real workflow reaches a measurable outcome through an accountable operating record.

products.name: Shop
products.job: Run orders, available-stock counts, purchasing and receipt, fulfilment, payment status, bounded returns, exceptions, versioned per-order tax calculation, daily close, native Spa prepaid-package sales and completed-treatment redemption, and a balanced review-only accounting handoff with correction settlement and source-document traceability from one accountable shop record.

localAutomation.workOrder: Shop: carry one named Spa owner from reviewed import through package sale, completed treatment, one package redemption, daily close, and recovery on an isolated managed tenant.
localAutomation.reason: The native candidate is locally verified. A named owner, reviewed client data, protected release, and approved isolated tenant are still required; sample evidence cannot close the pilot.

products.nextGate: One named Spa owner completes reviewed import, reconciled package sale, matching treatment redemption, daily close, and recovery on an isolated hosted tenant; record setup time, correction effort, and five-day evidence without treating sample data as client proof.

products.name: Plant
products.job: Run jobs, accountable short closes, output, job-linked material use, quality, equipment observations, maintenance, and shift exceptions from one plant record.

localAutomation.workOrder: Plant: validate one order-bound OEE window with an operator and supervisor on an isolated managed tenant.
localAutomation.reason: Needs named human timing evidence and approved managed tenant.

products.nextGate: Validate one order-bound OEE window with named operator and supervisor on isolated managed tenant; reconcile exact downtime source; measure correction effort before costing adapters.

products.name: Website
products.job: Turn an approved business brief into a finite, reviewable website and one deterministic downloadable site file.

localAutomation.workOrder: Website: run one named business brief through responsive review and retain the accepted managed artifact.
localAutomation.reason: Needs named business brief and accepted owner review; sample cannot close the gate.

products.nextGate: Complete one named-business brief through accepted responsive preview and retained managed artifact before connecting domain or publish authority.

products.name: Ecommerce
products.job: Create a simple customer storefront from a read-only Shop catalogue, quote a recoverable cart, send structured order intent into Shop, and retain accountable post-order help, return, and balance-review outcomes while Shop remains the only order, stock, payment, refund, tax, and correction authority.

localAutomation.workOrder: Ecommerce: prove checkout, acknowledgement, contact or delivery correction, and Shop replacement review with a named operator on one isolated managed tenant.
localAutomation.reason: ENG-146 done. Needs founder-selected operator and approved isolated managed tenant; automation cannot claim hosted persistence.

products.nextGate: Prove cart-to-Shop handoff and customer-safe acknowledgement on protected preview and isolated managed tenant; add tax, shipping, and payment adapters only behind accountable approval and duplicate-safe recovery.

sharedCapabilities.name: AI assistance
sharedCapabilities.job: Prepare bounded, reviewable work inside Shop, Plant, Website, and Ecommerce from approved records.
sharedCapabilities.nextGate: Pass the server-only golden-set evaluation for Order Intake with provenance, zero side effects, human review, and measured correction effort before exposing an interactive capability.

internalSystems.name: SuperMega HQ
internalSystems.job: Coordinate company work, evidence, exceptions, and owner decisions.

internalSystems.name: R&D and resource intelligence
internalSystems.job: Turn verified resources into implementation guidance.

researchGates.gate: Require managed persistence, tenant-authenticated callbacks, exactly-once order creation, and the assignment lease.
Require fixture evaluation, server-only structured output, provenance, budget, human review, and zero side effects.
Redact customer content; correlate request, workflow, model, tool, and database operations.
Require typed PII-free events, founder schema review, fresh-setup rendering, and reset deletion.
Sequence verified statements, staff roles, then shared workspace; each tier requires its named pilot and prior production proof.
Adopt only after measured row volume exceeds the native interface.
Require a measured simultaneous-operator refresh problem.
Require a documented failure of the existing record and worker runtime.

nonGoals: Commerce or Production as public product names
Fake autonomous employees or unreviewed external actions
Duplicate Shop and Ecommerce back offices
One page or domain per capability
